Orders ship from our warehouse in Fresno, California, so West Coast customers receive material in days. Every lot comes with a certificate of analysis, samples dispatch within 48 hours, and you get a commercial quotation within 48 hours.

sections.heading: What is coconut water powder
paragraphs: Coconut water powder is the dried form of the clear liquid inside tender green coconuts. We supply two types. Spray-dried powder dissolves instantly and suits hydration drinks and electrolyte blends. Freeze-dried powder is 100% coconut water with no carrier, dried at low temperature to keep the closest-to-fresh taste and aroma for premium clean-label beverages.
Both are naturally rich in potassium and give formulators the label appeal of coconut water without the weight, cold chain and shelf-life limits of the liquid.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for coconut water powder?
faqs.a: Standard orders start from one pallet, about 500 kg, in 25 kg packs. Smaller trial quantities and samples are available on request.

faqs.q: Do you supply organic coconut water powder?
faqs.a: Yes. Organic grades are available for both types. Ask for the organic certificate with your quote.

faqs.q: Does it contain maltodextrin or other carriers?
faqs.a: The freeze-dried powder is 100% coconut water with no carrier. The spray-dried powder is available with or without a carrier, to suit your formulation.

faqs.q: Is your coconut water powder freeze-dried or spray-dried?
faqs.a: Both. Spray-dried for instant solubility in drink mixes, and freeze-dried for the closest-to-fresh taste.
